source_authorities: Uttara Kalamritam (ఉత్తర కాలామృతం) by Mahakavi Kalidasa
Jataka Parijata (జాతక పారిజాతం) by Vaidyanatha Dikshita
Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (బృహత్ పరాశర హోరా శాస్త్రం)
Dharma Sindhu (ధర్మ సింధు) & Nirnaya Sindhu (నిర్ణయ సింధు)

bhavas_12.name: Tanu Bhava (లగ్న భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Body, vitality, character, constitution, appearance, life longevity.

bhavas_12.name: Dhana Bhava (ధన భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Wealth, speech, eyes, family, accumulated assets, primary education.

bhavas_12.name: Bhratru / Sahaja Bhava (భ్రాతృ భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Younger siblings, courage, valour, short journeys, communication skills.

bhavas_12.name: Matru / Sukha Bhava (మాతృ/సుఖ భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Mother, home, real estate, vehicles, peace of mind, formal education.

bhavas_12.name: Putra / Poorvapunya Bhava (పుత్ర/పూర్వపుణ్య భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Children, intellect, mantra siddhi, speculative gains, spiritual merit.

bhavas_12.name: Shatru / Roga Bhava (శత్రు/రోగ భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Enemies, debts, diseases, litigation, service, maternal uncles.

bhavas_12.name: Kalatra Bhava (కళత్ర భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Spouse, marriage, partnerships, public relations, foreign travels.

bhavas_12.name: Ayur / Randhra Bhava (ఆయుర్ భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Longevity, sudden unexpected events, hidden knowledge, transformation, legacies.

bhavas_12.name: Bhagya / Dharma Bhava (భాగ్య/ధర్మ భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Father, guru, fortune, spirituality, pilgrimages, higher knowledge.

bhavas_12.name: Karma Bhava (కర్మ భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Profession, authority, reputation, achievements, social status.

bhavas_12.name: Labha Bhava (లాభ భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Gains, elder siblings, fulfillment of desires, friends, network.

bhavas_12.name: Vyaya / Moksha Bhava (వ్యయ/మోక్ష భావం)
bhavas_12.significations: Expenditures, foreign settlements, spiritual liberation, sleep, hospitalizations.

rajayogas.name: Gajakesari Yoga
rajayogas.rule: Guru in Kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from Chandra or Lagna.
rajayogas.effect: Virtuous character, high fame, eloquence, lasting prosperity.

rajayogas.name: Budhaditya Yoga
rajayogas.rule: Surya and Budha in the same rashi (not combust within tight degrees).
rajayogas.effect: Keen intellect, administrative competence, royal or executive favor.

types.rule: Kuja in Kendra in Mesha, Vrishchika, or Makara.
Budha in Kendra in Mithuna or Kanya.
types.effect: Scholarly acumen, business mastery, long life.

types.rule: Guru in Kendra in Dhanus, Meena, or Karkataka.
types.effect: Saintly righteousness, respect from kings, religious wisdom.

types.rule: Shukra in Kendra in Vrishabha, Tula, or Meena.
types.effect: Sensory luxury, artistic brilliance, wealthy spouse, graceful lifestyle.

types.rule: Shani in Kendra in Makara, Kumbha, or Tula.
types.effect: Leadership of masses, organizational discipline, enduring power.

rajayogas.name: Vipareeta Rajayoga (Uttara Kalamritam Chapter 4)
rajayogas.rule: Lords of dusthanas (6, 8, 12) placed in other dusthanas without association with Kendra/Trikona lords: Harsha (6th in 6,8,12), Sarala (8th in 6,8,12), Vimala (12th in 6,8,12).
rajayogas.effect: Sudden elevation through adversity, inheritance of wealth, triumph over rivals.

kala_sarpa_dosha.rule: All 7 planets situated between Rahu and Ketu in the chart.
kala_sarpa_dosha.pariharam: Sri Subrahmanya Swami Abhishekam on Tuesdays/Shashthi, Sarpa Shanti puja at Srikalahasti or Kukke Subrahmanya, chanting Maha Mrityunjaya mantra.

pitru_dosha.rule: Surya or 9th lord afflicted by Rahu, Ketu, or Shani in 1st, 5th, or 9th house.
pitru_dosha.symptoms: Obstacles in progeny, domestic distress, financial stagnation.
pitru_dosha.pariharam: Perform Tila Tarpanam on Amavasya, donate sesame and food to Brahmins, Gaya or Rameswaram Shraddha, serve cows with grass.

gandanta_dosha.rule: Birth in Nakshatra sandhi: Jyeshtha-Moola, Ashlesha-Magha, Revati-Ashwini (boundary of water & fire signs).

details.Moola: 1st Pada affects father/family elders; 2nd/3rd/4th milder. Requires Moola Nakshatra Shanti on 27th day, Rudra Abhishekam, and Go-dana / Anna dana.
details.Ashlesha: 1st Pada auspicious, 2nd Pada causes expenditure, 3rd Pada affects mother, 4th Pada affects father. Shanti with Sarpa Sukta and Kalasha Snanam.
details.Jyeshtha: 1st Pada affects maternal uncle/elders, 4th Pada causes personal distress. Indra devata puja and Shanti on 27th day.
details.Revati: 4th Pada affects child or father; Shanti performed on Ashwini day.
details.Ashwini: 1st Pada affects father; Gold / Ashwa dana recommended.
details.Magha: 1st Pada affects mother or maternal lineage; Pitru tarpanam and Pitru Shanti.

gandanta_dosha.pariharam: Gandanta Shanti Kalasha Snanam on 27th day when the same birth nakshatra recurs with 27-pot abhisheka and Nakshatra Gayatri japa.

shraddha_tithi_nirnayam.rule: Aparahna Vyapini Tithi (4th of 5 daytime parts, approx 1:15 PM - 3:45 PM).
shraddha_tithi_nirnayam.kutapa_kalam: 11:36 AM - 12:24 PM (8th Muhurta of daytime), supreme for Pitru aradhana.
shraddha_tithi_nirnayam.rohina_kalam: 9th Muhurta of daytime, auspicious for Tarpanam completion.
shraddha_tithi_nirnayam.guideline: If tithi exists in Aparahna on two days, the day with greater Aparahna presence or the second day is taken according to Dharma Sindhu.

Surya.japa: Om Hram Hreem Hroum Sah Suryaya Namah (7,000 times)
Surya.dana: Wheat, copper, ruby, red cloth, jaggery

Chandra.japa: Om Shram Shreem Shroum Sah Chandraya Namah (11,000 times)
Chandra.dana: Rice, silver, pearl, white cloth, milk, curd

Kuja.stotram: Subrahmanya Ashtakam / Runa Vimochana Angaraka Stotram
Kuja.japa: Om Kram Kreem Kroum Sah Bhaumaya Namah (10,000 times)
Kuja.dana: Red lentils (Masoor dal), coral, copper, red sandalwood

Budha.japa: Om Bram Breem Broum Sah Budhaya Namah (9,000 times)
Budha.dana: Green gram (Moong dal), emerald, green cloth, bronze

Guru.japa: Om Gram Greem Groum Sah Gurave Namah (19,000 times)
Guru.dana: Bengal gram (Chana dal), yellow sapphire, gold, yellow cloth, turmeric

Shukra.japa: Om Dram Dreem Droum Sah Shukraya Namah (16,000 times)
Shukra.dana: White beans (Rajma/Kabuli chana), diamond, silver, white silk, ghee

Shani.japa: Om Pram Preem Proum Sah Shanaishcharaya Namah (23,000 times)
Shani.dana: Black sesame seeds (Tila), sesame oil, iron, blue sapphire, black cloth

Rahu.japa: Om Bhram Bhreem Bhroum Sah Rahave Namah (18,000 times)
Rahu.dana: Black gram (Urad dal), hessonite (Gomedha), lead, multi-colored blanket

Ketu.japa: Om Stram Streem Stroum Sah Ketave Namah (17,000 times)
Ketu.dana: Horse gram (Ulavalu), cat's eye (Vaidoorya), seven grains (Sapta Dhanya)
